answer: In a Proof of Agent network, an agent economy resists Sybil attacks via topological cut verifications and game-theoretic multi-agent auditing. To falsify trust graphs, adversaries must bridge sparse graph bottlenecks across a rugged karst landscape of agent clusters, requiring exponential attacker cost in identity-bonding capital. Auditing agents stake tokens to challenge suspicious clusters; proven collusion triggers stake slashing that propagates a fatal ripple through the network to shatter fraud like brittle opal.
